verdict.rationale: Simular documents Sai working across the whole OS, including desktop apps, browsers, files and terminals, so a single task can span several apps. It keeps running after you close the laptop and only notifies you or asks for approval when it needs you or before sensitive steps like sending, paying or deleting. Saved workflows heal themselves when the UI changes and can rerun on a schedule, which directly supports hands-off multi-step execution. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that long cross-app tasks actually finish without intervention, and documented success or reliability metrics beyond vendor claims.
